set -eu
log=/var/log/inventory/app.log
before_inode=$(stat -c %i "$log")
(
  exec 3>>"$log"
  printf '%s\n' 'persistent-writer-before-rotation' >&3
  sleep 2
  printf '%s\n' 'persistent-writer-after-rotation' >&3
) &
writer_pid=$!
sleep 1
logrotate --force --verbose /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app
wait "$writer_pid"
after_inode=$(stat -c %i "$log")
printf 'inode_before=%s inode_after=%s\n' "$before_inode" "$after_inode"
